title: The two decisions that stay with a person

record.surface: the page, full width if you can, with Your decisions in shot
actions: press Request roadside assistance first. It is the requirement beat 05 put on screen, the one the rule pack answers with a human action instead of a field, and get_assistance_options reads it out without being able to close it
then press File this claim with the pointer, slowly enough to see
unpin nothing, and change no field on the draft
must_show: the Request roadside assistance button being pressed by hand, and the line that replaces it naming the time you pressed it
the roadside collection entry in the requirements list closing once you have pressed it
the File this claim button being pressed by hand
the filed line that appears underneath it
the sentence on the panel saying these buttons are never registered as agent tools
record.note: The order is forced by the product, not by preference. assistanceApplies in src/ui/app.js requires claim.status !== 'filed', so the assistance button closes the moment the claim is filed. Press it first or it cannot be pressed at all. Whatever else the requirements panel still shows is left alone and is not staged: filing is gated on the required fields through validateClaim, not on this insurer's intake list, so the page allows a filing with an intake requirement open and the take should show whatever is true on the day.
